title: Hidden weapons bunker under a fake generator at Saddam's compound

tellings.quote: found out that it was hollow and that it would tilt back. And when it tilted back, there were steps going down into a weapons bunker that you wouldn't believe.

plain: At a private facility belonging to Saddam Hussein, the former ruler of Iraq, what looked like a generator turned out to be hollow, and it tilted back to show steps leading down into a huge hidden weapons bunker. An Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan tells this as something he took part in uncovering, describing the bunker as one 'you wouldn't believe.'
